mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) and low monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicate a 'stagflationary' environment where central banks are constrained, causing equity valuations to contract and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.25% in the last month), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in the last month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 units signals labor market recovery, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS monthly increase > 100,000, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
